brief: Prioritise clearance work if an obstruction defect is outstanding, as restricted airflow removes the cooling margin the unit relies on during sustained high ambient conditions (SOP-011). Bring forward the detailed inspection of the asset ahead of the heat event because the time elapsed since the last completed maintenance makes its cooling system unverified (REG-042). Because the unit has advanced age and a history of high loading, it has a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023).
